$$
\begin{aligned}

\nabla g(1,-2)&=\langle 4(1)(1-2),2(1-2)\rangle\\

\end{aligned}

$$

&=\frac{(-4)(-3)+(-2)(4)}{5}\\
&=\frac{12-8}{5}=\frac{4}{5}.
